What to look for: this should compile, and current compilers do. The link shows
current behaviour rather than the historical crash.

Expect clean SPIR-V with six OpString entries and a DebugPrintf import, and six
matching OpExtInst calls in main.

Note this runs WITHOUT the "-fcgl -Vd" the issue used to avoid a separate
SPIRV-Tools crash. That crash was fixed by SPIRV-Tools#4280, and dropping the
flags means legalization and validation run here.

Compiler Explorer cannot show the failure: its oldest DXC is 1.6.2112, which
is the first clean release in the measured history. The crash reproduced in
1.6.2104 and 1.6.2106 as intermittent heap corruption.
